services.desc: is the national sport of Thailand, and has a long and rich history in Thai culture. Muay Thai (Thai Boxing) is extremely popular throughout the world, and is recognized as an extremely effective form of hand-to-hand combat. Practitioners of Muay Thai use punches, kicks, knees, elbows, clinch-work and throws to inflict damage and knock out their opponents. Muay Thai is also one of the quickest ways to get in shape, as workouts develop cardio, speed, strength, agility, power, and overall coordination. Most of all, Muay Thai is fun to learn!
